_doc: Identity + consume contract for the published AIOX framework core. The publish workflow (.github/workflows/publish-aiox-core.yml) packs this whole .aiox-core/ tree as an OCI artifact to ghcr.io/synkraai/aiox-core:<version> and ASSERTS the git tag matches `version` below (drift guard). Bump `version` + tag `aiox-core-v<version>` to release.
name: aiox-core
description: AIOX dev-environment framework SOT — CLI-agnostic skills/agents/rules/services + the projector. Consumed by AIOX projects (sinkra-hub is the first client).

consume._model_doc: aiox-core is the BASE dev framework (the curated agnostic subset). A client project keeps its own project-specific layer ON TOP — the consume must never clobber project-authored skills/rules. See docs/distribution/aiox-core-publishing.md § Overlay precedence.
